description: Source code for a simple RAM logging module in C, including functions for initialization, writing characters and strings, formatted printing, and device interface setup.

methods.name: ramlog_chr
methods.description: Writes a single character to the ramlog buffer, wrapping around if the buffer is full.

methods.name: ramlog_fputs
methods.description: Writes a null-terminated string to the ramlog buffer.

methods.name: ramlog_puts
methods.description: Writes a string followed by a newline to the ramlog buffer.

methods.name: ramlog_printf
methods.description: Performs formatted printing to the ramlog via a FILE pointer.

methods.name: ramlog_init
methods.description: Initializes the ramlog system, opens the ramlog file, and manages session info.

methods.name: Ramlog_Write
methods.description: Writes data to the ramlog buffer.

methods.name: Ramlog_Open
methods.description: Stub function for opening the ramlog device.
